$comment: Pack textures with their static shade baked in (bake_textures.py writes textures/<name>; build.py fails when one is stale). A shade is the linear-gradient the element drew over its cover image every frame: top colour/alpha to bottom colour/alpha over the element's padding box. box: that box in dp at the design size (915x412), which fixes how `cover` maps the element onto the picture; on other aspects the same linear shade runs on past the box.
